42450-housekeeping-in-old-virginia.title: Housekeeping In Old Virginia
42450-housekeeping-in-old-virginia.creator: Unknown
42450-housekeeping-in-old-virginia.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Virginia, or the Old Dominion, as her children delight to call her, has always been famed for the style of her living. Taught by the example of her royal colonial governors, and the numerous adherents of King Charles, who brought hither in their exile the graces and luxuriousness of his brilliant court, she became noted among the colonies for the princely hospitality of her people and for the beauty and richness of their living.

76131-the-mark-of-the-monster.creator: Unknown

arxiv-1902-10640.title: Efficient Video Classification Using Fewer Frames
arxiv-1902-10640.creator: Shweta Bhardwaj, Mukundhan Srinivasan, Mitesh M. Khapra
arxiv-1902-10640.description: Abstract Recently, there has been a lot of interest in building compact models for video classification which have a small memory footprint ( < < 1 GB) summary-paper . While these models are compact, they typically operate by repeated application of a small weight matrix to all the frames in a video.

arxiv-2012-11521.title: Experimental characterization of quantum many-body localization transition
arxiv-2012-11521.creator: Ming Gong 1,2,3, Gentil D. de Moraes Neto 4, Chen Zha 1,2,3, Yulin Wu 1,2,3, Hao Rong 1,2,3, Yangsen Ye 1,2,3, Shaowei Li 1,2,3, Qingling Zhu 1,2,3, Shiyu Wang 1,2,3, Youwei Zhao 1,2,3, Futian Liang 1,2,3, Jin Lin 1,2,3, Yu Xu 1,2,3, Cheng-Zhi Peng 1,2,3, Hui Deng 1,2,3, Abolfazl Bayat 4, Xiaobo Zhu
arxiv-2012-11521.description: Abstract As strength of disorder enhances beyond a threshold value in many-body systems, a fundamental transformation happens through which the entire spectrum localizes, a phenomenon known as many-body localization. This has profound implications as it breaks down fundamental principles of statistical mechanics, such as thermalization and ergodicity.

arxiv-2107-13843.title: VBR: Version Based Reclamation
arxiv-2107-13843.creator: Gali Sheffi, Maurice Herlihy, Erez Petrank
arxiv-2107-13843.description: Abstract Safe lock-free memory reclamation is a difficult problem. Existing solutions follow three basic methods (or their combinations): epoch based reclamation, hazard pointers, and optimistic reclamation. Epoch-based methods are fast, but do not guarantee lock-freedom. Hazard pointer solutions are lock-free but typically do not provide high performance.

arxiv-2212-04899.title: Improving quantum state transfer: Correcting non-Markovian and distortion effects
arxiv-2212-04899.creator: Guillermo F. Peñas, Ricardo Puebla, Juan José García-Ripoll
arxiv-2212-04899.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Guillermo F. Peñas, Ricardo Puebla, Juan José García-Ripoll. Quantum state transfer is a key operation for quantum information processing. The original pitch-and-catch protocols rely on flying qubits or single photons with engineered wavepacket shapes to achieve a deterministic, fast and high-fidelity transfer. Yet, these protocols overlook two important factors, namely, the distortion of the wavepacket during the propagation and non-Markovian effects during the emission and reabsorption processes due to time-dependent controls.

arxiv-2307-09684.title: Sparse estimation of parameter support sets for generalized vector autoregressions by resampling and model aggregation
arxiv-2307-09684.creator: Trevor D. Ruiz, Sharmodeep Bhattacharyya, and Sarah C. Emerson
arxiv-2307-09684.description: Abstract The central problem we address in this work is estimation of the parameter support set S S , the set of indices corresponding to nonzero parameters, in the context of a sparse parametric likelihood model for discrete multivariate time series.

arxiv-2312-08511.title: The Relative Value of Prediction in Algorithmic Decision Making
arxiv-2312-08511.creator: Juan Carlos Perdomo
arxiv-2312-08511.description: Abstract Algorithmic predictions are increasingly used to inform the allocations of goods and interventions in the public sphere. In these domains, predictions serve as a means to an end. They provide stakeholders with insights into likelihood of future events as a means to improve decision making quality, and enhance social welfare.

arxiv-2410-11620.title: Exploring the effect of different cosmologies on the Epoch of Reionization 21-cm signal with Polar
arxiv-2410-11620.creator: Anshuman Acharya, Qing-bo Ma, Sambit K. Giri, Benedetta Ciardi, Raghunath Ghara, Garrelt Mellema, Saleem Zaroubi, Ian Hothi, Ilian T. Iliev, Léon V. E. Koopmans, Michele Bianco
arxiv-2410-11620.description: Abstract A detection of the 21-cm signal power spectrum from the Epoch of Reionization is imminent, thanks to consistent advancements from telescopes such as LOFAR, MWA, and HERA, along with the development of SKA. In light of this progress, it is crucial to expand the parameter space of simulations used to infer astrophysical properties from this signal.

arxiv-2505-01723.title: Transition from near-field to extreme near-field radiative heat transfer
arxiv-2505-01723.creator: F. Geesmann, P. Thurau, S. Rodehutskors, T. Ziehm, L. Worbes, S.-A. Biehs, A. Kittel
arxiv-2505-01723.description: Abstract The radiative heat transfer in the extreme near-field regime, i.e. for distances below 10 nm, remains poorly understood. There are competing experimental results in this regime, with some in good agreement with theoretical predictions, while others report drastically elevated heat fluxes, orders of magnitude larger than what theory suggests.

arxiv-2507-04469.title: The role of large language models in UI/UX design: A systematic literature review
arxiv-2507-04469.creator: Ammar Ahmed, Ali Shariq Imran
arxiv-2507-04469.description: Abstract This systematic literature review examines the role of large language models (LLMs) in UI/UX design, synthesizing findings from 38 peer-reviewed studies published between 2022 and 2025. We identify key LLMs in use, including GPT-4, Gemini, and PaLM, and map their integration across the design lifecycle, from ideation to evaluation. Common practices include prompt engineering, human-in-the-loop workflows, and multimodal input.

pmc-10495869.creator: Chang Lei, Diyang Qu, Kunxu Liu, Runsen Chen
pmc-10495869.description: Key PointsQuestionTo what extent does the analysis of daily data encompassing mood fluctuations and contextual stressful events effectively predict short- and long-term suicidal ideation in sexual and gender minority individuals?FindingsThis diagnostic study of 103 individuals aged 18 to 29 years found that using 25-day ecological momentary assessment yielded acceptable prediction performance on 1-, 3-, and 8-month suicidal ideation.

pmc-10535943.creator: Małgorzata Kałucka, Aleksander Roszczyk, Marzenna Klimaszewska, Beata Kaleta, Ewelina Drelich, Anna Błażewicz, Sandra Górska-Jakubowska, Eliza Malinowska, Marek Król, Aleksandra Maria Prus, Katarzyna Trześniowska, Aleksandra Wołczyńska, Przemysław Dorożyński, Radosław Zagożdżon, Jadwiga Turło

Mycelial cultures of Lentinula edodes, an edible and medicinal mushroom, have been used in our previous research to obtain selenium-containing immunomodulatory preparations. Our current attempts to obtain a new preparation containing both selenium and zinc, two micronutrients necessary for the functioning of the immune system, extended our interest in the simultaneous accumulation of these elements by mycelia growing in media enriched with selenite and zinc(II) ions. Subsequently, we have studied the effects of new L.

pmc-10694312.title: Epidemiology of respiratory pathogens in patients with acute respiratory tract infection in Xiamen, China: A retrospective survey from 2020 to 2022
pmc-10694312.creator: Shan Hong, Dan Li, Yanli Wei, Yilin Zheng, Jiading Cai, Heping Zheng, Xuan Zhang, Yulin Deng, Dandan Han, Jia Wang, Linlin Chen, Shujing Li, Weiping Qiu, Min Ren, Liangneng Zou
pmc-10694312.description: Acute respiratory tract infections (ARTI) are caused by respiratory pathogens and range from asymptomatic infections to severe respiratory diseases. These diseases can be life threatening with high morbidity and mortality worldwide. Under the pandemic of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19), little has been reported about the pathogen etiologies and epidemiology of patients suffering from ARTI of all age in Xiamen.

pmc-10712252.title: Age-Related Effect of Uric Acid on Contrast-Induced Acute Kidney Injury of Patients Undergoing Coronary Angiography
pmc-10712252.creator: Jin Lu, Yibo He, Yanfang Yang, Xuejing Zhong, Shaowen Chen, Bo Wu, Yuxiong Pan, Yizhang Wang, Jiaming Xiu, Yu Kang, Jin Liu, Yong Liu, Shiqun Chen, Kaihong Chen, Liling Chen
pmc-10712252.description: BackgroundThe association between uric acid (UA) and contrast-induced acute kidney injury (CI-AKI) following coronary angiography (CAG) has been established. However, whether the association would vary with age remained undetermined.MethodsWe performed the retrospective analysis based on the Cardio-renal Improvement II study, (ClinicalTrials.gov NCT05050877), which enrolled consecutive patients undergoing coronary angiography in 5 teaching hospitals in China from 2007 to 2020.

pmc-11312136.title: Application of Geographic Information Systems (GIS) in the Study of Prostate Cancer Disparities: A Systematic Review
pmc-11312136.creator: Christiane J El Khoury
pmc-11312136.description: Simple SummaryProstate cancer (PCa) has significant disparities based on geography, affecting healthcare access and outcomes. This study reviews how Geographic Information Systems (GIS) are used to research these disparities. GIS helps visualize PCa incidence, survival, and mortality trends, but its application varies, leading to inconsistent results. The review followed Cochrane and PRISMA guidelines, analyzing 25 relevant studies.

pmc-11403607.title: Husk Separation (Kubessa Method) Impacts the Aging Chemistry of Beer
pmc-11403607.creator: Stefan A. Pieczonka, Lukas Brass, Florian Lehnhardt, Jens Eiken, Alexa Wachtler, Leopold Weidner, John Brauer, Michael Rychlik, Martina Gastl, Philippe Schmitt-Kopplin, Martin Zarnkow
pmc-11403607.description: The removal of husks before the mashing process, also known as the Kubessa method, is an established brewing practice often positively associated with smoothness and better flavor-stability of beer. Empirical evidence on the effect of the Kubessa method on beer, however, has been lacking.

pmc-11425131.title: Extrachromosomal circular DNA-related SPOCK1 contributes to development and enzalutamide resistance of prostate cancer by regulating epithelial mesenchymal transition
pmc-11425131.creator: Yicong Yao, Qinghua Wang, Wei Jiang, Haopeng Li, Xilei Li, Tong Zi, Xin Qin, Yan Zhao, Denglong Wu, Gang Wu
pmc-11425131.description: Prostate cancer is a significant contributor to cancer-related mortality, and the tumor typically develops into castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC). Hence, few effective clinical strategies are available to patients with advanced disease. Extrachromosomal circular DNA (eccDNA) is a type of circular DNA originating from the chromosomes but is likely independent of them.

pmc-11537922.title: Case study: lessons learned from a community-based early frailty intervention programme in Singapore
pmc-11537922.creator: Kamala Priya Jayaprakash, Rachel Ngo, Elianna Lee, Pey Ling Chng, Hengky Lee, Salan Chua, Deborah Lee, Carina Wong, Viknessh S
pmc-11537922.description: Frailty is a dynamic and evolving state of health which involves the gradual loss of physiological in-built reserves. In Singapore, there is growing interest in delivering frailty intervention programmes at scale in the community to meet the demands of an ageing population.

pmc-11620192.title: A prospective Real-Life Multicenter Study of Tildrakizumab 200 mg in Patients with Moderate-Severe Psoriasis: Who is the Ideal Patient?

pmc-12110557.title: Survival Status and Associated Factors among Under-Five Children Managed with Congenital Heart Diseases in Addis Ababa Ethiopia: A Retrospective Follow-up Study
pmc-12110557.creator: Daba Suyum Jaleta, Girum Sebsibie Teshome, Yeshi Birhan Nega, Yosief Tsigie Radie
pmc-12110557.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundCongenital heart disease is the most prevalent congenital abnormality with a prevalence of 9 per 1000 live births. Despite the advancements in medical and surgical care, congenital heart disease is high in developing countries including Ethiopia. The aim of this study is to assess Survival status and associated factors of under-five children managed with congenital heart diseases in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.MethodsAn Institution-based retrospective follow-up study design was used among under-five children managed with congenital heart disease.

pmc-12436859.title: Dementia with Lewy bodies: a review of disease-modifying therapies for α-synucleinopathies
pmc-12436859.creator: A. Dar, S. Bhattacharyya
pmc-12436859.description: IntroductionNeurodegenerative disease prevalence is high in the elderly, as aged brains accumulate molecular and cellular damage. Protein misfolding and aggregation are pathological processes underlying neurodegeneration, as seen in dementia. This coupled with oxidative stress, disrupted ubiquitin-proteosome system and neuroinflammation may contribute to neuronal damage.

pmc-12627712.title: Clinical outcomes of liposomal and conventional bupivacaine in postoperative pain management in female patients following thoracoscopic lung surgery
pmc-12627712.creator: Dongsheng Lu, Zehao Huang, Huajian Peng, Jianji Guo, Zhanyu Xu, Nuo Yang
pmc-12627712.description: This study compared liposomal bupivacaine (LB) and conventional bupivacaine hydrochloride (BH) for postoperative pain management among 50 female patients undergoing uniportal thoracoscopic lung surgery. The patients were randomized to LB (n = 25) or BH (n = 25) groups based on the intercostal nerve blocks they received post-surgery.

pmc-13096157.title: Regulation of the AKT/P53 signaling pathway by translated control tumor protein inhibits apoptosis and promotes hyperplasia of the mammary glands
pmc-13096157.creator: Mu-Yuan Ma, Sheng Wang, Xue-Mei Jin, Yue Shen, Yi-Min Cai, Bin Yu, Huan-Huan Du, Liu Jia, Lei Ma, Jun-Fei Zhang

In this study, the TCTP (Tpt1flox/flox) and TCTP (Tpt1KI/KI) gene mice were respectively mated with MMTV-Cre to obtain mice withmammary glands-specific TCTP knockout (TCTP cKO) and overexpression (TCTP KI).
